facts.claim: Colombia's proven natural gas reserves fell 17% year-over-year to 1.717 trillion cubic feet at the end of 2025, an 18-year low
facts.subject: Colombia natural gas reserves
facts.cause: lack of new discoveries and substantial drop in output from Chuchupa and Ballena offshore fields

facts.claim: Colombia's natural gas production in April 2026 reached 694 million cubic feet per day, down 15% year-over-year
facts.subject: Colombia natural gas production
facts.cause: depletion of major offshore gas fields and declining reserves

facts.claim: Colombia's projected natural gas imports are expected to rise to over 32% of total consumption in 2026, up from earlier forecasts of 25%
facts.subject: Colombia natural gas imports
facts.cause: declining domestic natural gas production combined with predicted Super El Niño reducing hydroelectric generation

facts.claim: Natural gas prices in Colombia are estimated to rise by approximately 25% during 2026
facts.subject: Colombia natural gas prices
facts.cause: rising dependence on expensive liquified natural gas imports due to declining domestic production

facts.claim: Colombia's annual inflation rate reached 5.84% in May 2026, the highest level since 2024
facts.subject: Colombia inflation
facts.cause: surging natural gas prices and rising costs of costly LNG imports impacting businesses and households
